description: §19.16.2 — a `?` propagation exit runs the block's deferred bodies. outer() writes "open;", registers the "close;" write, then `load("k1")?` propagates Missing("k1"); the statement after it never runs, the deferred body does: trace = "open;close;", @result = "missing k1".
rationale: §19.16.2 Exit lists `?` propagation (§19.5) — it returns the error from the enclosing function, which is an exit of the function body block, so the registered deferred body runs before the error reaches the caller's `!{}` handler.
